# First, filter the dataframe to only include rows within the year range 1995 to 2009 (inclusive)
df_filtered = df[(df['year'] >= 1995) & (df['year'] <= 2009)]

# Count the number of prizes (rows) for each beer within this filtered range
prize_counts = df_filtered['beer name'].value_counts()

# Identify the beer(s) with the maximum count
max_count = prize_counts.max()
most_decorated_beers = prize_counts[prize_counts == max_count].index.tolist()

# Check if 'maggs magnificent mild' is among the most decorated beers (and if it's the only one)
answer = 'maggs magnificent mild' in most_decorated_beers and len(most_decorated_beers) == 1
